final: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactionrecord AS r JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT trader_type, transaction_count, SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS total_count, AVG(transaction_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT trader_type, transaction_count, 1.0 * transaction_count / total_count AS share_of_total, transaction_count - average_count AS above_average FROM totals WHERE transaction_count > average_count
